content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "GameStarted"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| summarize Games=count(), AvgPlayers=round(avg(todouble(d.PlayerCount)),1), AvgBots=round(avg(todouble(d.BotCount)),1)

traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "GameStarted"
| summarize Games=count() by bin(timestamp, 1d)
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: 📈 Games Per Day

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "GameEnded"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| summarize AvgDurationSec=round(avg(todouble(d.DurationSeconds)),0), MedianDurationSec=round(percentile(todouble(d.DurationSeconds),50),0), AvgTurns=round(avg(todouble(d.TurnCount)),0), MedianTurns=round(percentile(todouble(d.TurnCount),50),0), GamesCompleted=count()
content.title: ⏱️ Game Duration & Turns

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name contains "GameHub"
| where client_CountryOrRegion != ""
| summarize Sessions=dcount(client_IP) by client_CountryOrRegion
| order by Sessions desc
content.title: Players Map

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name contains "GameHub"
| extend City = client_City, Country = client_CountryOrRegion, IP = client_IP
| summarize Requests=count(), LastSeen=max(timestamp) by Country, City, IP
| order by LastSeen desc
content.title: Players by Location & IP

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "GameEnded"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| extend WinnerIsBot = tobool(d.WinnerIsBot)
| summarize Wins=count() by WinnerType=iff(WinnerIsBot, "🤖 Bot", "👤 Human")
content.title: Win Rate: Human vs Bot

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "CardPlayed"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| where tobool(d.PlayedAsMoney) == false
| extend CardType = tostring(d.CardType), ActionType = tostring(d.ActionType)
| extend CardLabel = iff(CardType == "Action", ActionType, CardType)
| summarize Count=count() by CardLabel
| order by Count desc
| take 15
content.title: Most Played Card Types

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "ActionResponse"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| extend ResponseType = tostring(d.ResponseType), PlayerIsBot = tobool(d.PlayerIsBot)
| summarize Count=count() by ResponseType, PlayerType=iff(PlayerIsBot, "Bot", "Human")
| order by Count desc
content.title: Action Responses (JSN vs Pay)

content.json:
## 🎮 Game Drill-Down
Click a game row to see its full timeline.

content.query:
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith "GameStarted"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| join kind=leftouter (
    traces
    | where message startswith "GameEnded"
    | extend ed = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
    | project GameId=tostring(ed.GameId), Duration=strcat(tostring(toint(todouble(ed.DurationSeconds))), "s"), Turns=tostring(ed.TurnCount), Winner=tostring(ed.WinnerName), WinnerIsBot=tostring(ed.WinnerIsBot)
) on $left.tostring(d.GameId) == $right.GameId
| project Timestamp=timestamp, GameId=tostring(d.GameId), GameCode=tostring(d.GameCode), Players=toint(d.PlayerCount), Bots=toint(d.BotCount), Duration=coalesce(Duration, "in progress"), Turns=coalesce(Turns, "-"), Winner=coalesce(Winner, "-")
| order by Timestamp desc
content.title: All Games

content.query:
traces
| where customDimensions.GameId == "{SelectedGameId}"
| where message startswith "GameEnded"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| project Duration=strcat(tostring(toint(todouble(d.DurationSeconds))), " seconds"), Turns=tostring(d.TurnCount), Winner=tostring(d.WinnerName), WinnerIsBot=iff(tobool(d.WinnerIsBot), "🤖 Yes", "👤 No"), Players=tostring(d.PlayerCount), Bots=tostring(d.BotCount)
content.title: 🏆 Game Result: {SelectedGameId}

content.query:
traces
| where customDimensions.GameId == "{SelectedGameId}"
| extend d = parse_json(tostring(customDimensions))
| project Timestamp=timestamp, Event=extract(@"^(\w+)", 1, message), Turn=tostring(d.TurnNumber), IsBot=iff(tobool(d.PlayerIsBot), "🤖", "👤"), CardType=tostring(d.CardType), CardName=tostring(d.CardName), Action=tostring(d.ActionType), AsMoney=iff(tobool(d.PlayedAsMoney), "💰", ""), Response=tostring(d.ResponseType)
| order by Timestamp asc
content.title: 📋 Game Timeline: {SelectedGameId}
